task: Evidence-only per-character aura colour reference review

latestUserDirection.lightning: Remove lightning for EVERY character, including Cell and Gohan SSJ2
latestUserDirection.artDirection: Consider colours by character/type and original game; no palette or ROM edit authorised by this research ledger

summary: Original Buyuu has a common yellow/gold-grey aura. Golden/yellow for the four Super Saiyans has official general support. Distinct ordinary charging hues for seven non-SSJ fighters remain unverified here; no skin/projectile-to-aura inference is made.
searchBoundary: Official Dragon Ball website, creator Team Z2 website/movelist, original ROM and existing before-C2 local emulator captures. No anime episode colour frames or Team Z2 live charging captures were extracted in this short pass.

sources.title: Buyuu Retsuden native shared charge aura
facts: A single common charge-aura map at0x9F0A uses palette bank3; common graphics at0xB6F0 decompress to1440bytes/45tiles.
Common CRAM colours come from0x9102. The original aura uses indices7,8,9,15: pale yellow, amber, dark warm outline and light-grey core.
This effect does not supply eleven independently coloured aura palettes. Piccolo and Ginyu are not green/purple charge auras in this source.
sources.scopeLimit: Original game art is evidence for the game, not a claim about canonical anime colours.

sources.title: Comparing the Worlds of Dragon Ball and Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot — Iconic Scenes
sources.observation: Official article identifies the aura of Super Saiyans as golden when discussing the recreated first transformation scene.
sources.shortQuote: golden aura that radiates from all Super Saiyans
sources.supports: Golden/yellow colour family for SSJ Goku, SSJ/SSJ2 Gohan, SSJ Vegeta and SSJ Trunks.
sources.doesNotSupport: Exact DBZ anime cel palette/hex values, every scene, or colours of non-Saiyans. The example shown is Kakarot, not a measured original DBZ animation frame.
sources.confidence: high for the broad golden SSJ family; unverified for exact original-anime colour samples

sources.title: Hyper DBZ — About the Game
sources.observation: Team Z2 distinguishes its own build from fan-made Z2-inspired additions and directs users to its own site for official downloads.
sources.supports: Source-authenticity boundary: an arbitrary HDBZ-labelled fan character is not proof of a Team Z2 aura palette.
sources.doesNotSupport: This page does not list charging-aura colours by character.

sources.title: Hyper DBZ — Wicked Ambition
sources.observation: Official game landing page and trailer/download links were located; no per-character aura colour was measured in this bounded review.
sources.doesNotSupport: No claim that the eleven Buyuu fighters all have Team Z2 counterparts, or that their hues were verified.

sources.title: Power Mode — Piccolo
sources.observation: Text describes a mode meter/kanji progressing grey/yellow/orange/red and separate explosive/projectile moves.
sources.doesNotSupport: Those UI colours and attack descriptions do not establish the colour of Piccolo ordinary body-enveloping charge aura. No green aura inferred from his skin.
sources.imageInspectionLimit: Linked PNGs could not be fetched by the browsing tool; no visual-colour conclusion is drawn from their filenames.

sources.title: General Gameplay Information — Power Charge
sources.observation: Defines Power Charge as manually filling the power meter; no body-aura colour table is given.
sources.supports: Distinction between the charge action, UI meters and offensive ki projectiles.

sources.title: Power Mode — Eighteen
sources.observation: Cold Mode changes the energy meter and disables Power Charge in that mode.
sources.doesNotSupport: The mode name or meter colours do not prove an ice-blue charging aura for Android18.

sources.title: Weekly Character Showcase239 — Ginyu from Dragon Ball Super
sources.observation: Mentions an aura for body changing in Dragon Ball Super.
sources.excludedReason: Wrong effect and series context for DBZ Namek charging aura. Not evidence for a purple ordinary charge aura.

sources.title: Sparking ZERO recreates Ultimate Moves
sources.observation: Describes red-black colouring of Frieza Death Ball in Sparking ZERO.
sources.excludedReason: Death Ball is a projectile, not his body-enveloping power-up aura. Later-game styling cannot be substituted for a verified DBZ charge reference.

negativeFindingsAreBounded: Unverified here does not mean a colour never appears in the anime or HDBZ. It means this pass does not provide that specific evidence.
nextEvidenceNeeded: Identify an ordinary body-charge scene in original DBZ for each non-SSJ fighter, not a projectile or body-change effect.
Capture official Team Z2 build at a named character/default palette/normal charge state; keep its artistic convention separate from original anime.
Treat any new non-SSJ colour family chosen before that as a design proposal for user review, not a canonical claim.
